value.name: man weighs her statement
value.description: He silently considers whether her remark refers to Devin or to her.
evidence: he was deciding whether to treat what she had just told him as a sentence about Devin or a sentence about her

value.name: clock marks his hesitation
value.description: The small clock ticks off the seconds while he hesitates over how to interpret her words.
evidence: The small clock on the credenza marked off the seconds

value.name: she waits without softening
value.description: She waits for him to choose a word and does not make the waiting any easier.
evidence: She waited for him to choose a word, and did not soften the waiting.
